english: Mercury takes about 88 Earth days to orbit the Sun.
chinese: 水星绕太阳公转一周约需 88 个地球日。

english: Venus takes longer to rotate once than it does to orbit the Sun.
chinese: 金星自转一周比绕太阳公转一周还久。

english: Venus is hotter at the surface than Mercury because of its thick atmosphere.
chinese: 金星的大气层很厚，表面温度比水星更高。

english: Mars has two small moons named Phobos and Deimos.
chinese: 火星有两颗小卫星，分别叫火卫一和火卫二。

english: Mars looks reddish because many of its surface rocks and dust contain iron oxides.
chinese: 火星表面的许多岩石和尘埃含有氧化铁，因此呈红褐色。

english: Olympus Mons on Mars is a giant shield volcano.
chinese: 火星上的奥林帕斯山是一座巨型盾状火山。

english: Jupiter is the largest planet in the solar system.
chinese: 木星是太阳系中最大的行星。

english: Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a long-lived storm.
chinese: 木星的大红斑是一场持续了很久的风暴。

english: Saturn's rings contain countless pieces of ice and rock.
chinese: 土星光环由无数冰块和岩石碎片组成。

english: The average density of Saturn is lower than that of liquid water.
chinese: 土星的平均密度比液态水还低。

english: Uranus spins with its axis tilted almost onto its side.
chinese: 天王星的自转轴倾斜得几乎与轨道平面平行。

english: Methane in Neptune's atmosphere absorbs red light.
chinese: 海王星大气中的甲烷会吸收红光。

english: Ceres orbits the Sun in the asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter.
chinese: 谷神星位于火星和木星之间的小行星带。

english: Pluto's largest moon is Charon.
chinese: 冥王星最大的卫星是卡戎，也叫冥卫一。

english: One orbit of Pluto takes about 248 Earth years.
chinese: 冥王星公转一周约需 248 个地球年。

english: Mercury and Venus have no natural moons.
chinese: 水星和金星都没有天然卫星。

english: Ganymede, a moon of Jupiter, is wider than Mercury.
chinese: 木星的卫星木卫三直径比水星还大。

english: Io, a moon of Jupiter, has active volcanoes.
chinese: 木星的卫星木卫一上有活火山。

english: Europa's icy surface is thought to cover an ocean of liquid water.
chinese: 科学家认为木卫二的冰壳下可能有一片液态海洋。

english: Titan has lakes and seas of liquid hydrocarbons on its surface.
chinese: 土卫六的表面有由液态碳氢化合物组成的湖泊和海洋。

english: Enceladus sprays water vapor and ice grains into space.
chinese: 土卫二会向太空喷出水蒸气和冰粒。

english: The tail of a comet does not always trail behind its path around the Sun.
chinese: 彗尾不一定拖在彗星运行方向的后方。

english: A meteoroid that reaches the ground is called a meteorite.
chinese: 落到地面的流星体残片叫陨石。

english: Many meteor showers occur when Earth crosses dust left along a comet's orbit.
chinese: 许多流星雨发生在地球穿过彗星轨道上留下的尘埃带时。

english: A light-year measures distance.
chinese: 光年衡量的是距离，等于光在真空中一年走过的路程。

english: The Sun contains more than 99 percent of the mass of the solar system.
chinese: 整个太阳系超过 99% 的质量集中在太阳上。

english: A solar eclipse can occur when the Moon passes between Earth and the Sun.
chinese: 月球运行到地球和太阳之间并挡住部分阳光时，就可能发生日食。

english: A lunar eclipse occurs when the Moon passes through Earth's shadow.
chinese: 月球经过地球的影子时会发生月食。

english: The far side of the Moon receives sunlight too.
chinese: 月球背面也能照到阳光。

english: The Moon keeps nearly the same face toward Earth because it rotates once per orbit.
chinese: 月球自转和绕地球公转的周期相同，因此总是以近乎同一面对着地球。

english: Earth's seasons are mainly caused by the tilt of its rotation axis.
chinese: 地球的四季主要由自转轴倾斜造成。

english: At an equinox, the Sun crosses the celestial equator.
chinese: 春分和秋分时，太阳在天空中的视位置经过天赤道。

english: The Milky Way is a barred spiral galaxy.
chinese: 银河系是一座棒旋星系。

english: Our solar system is located in a region of the Milky Way called the Orion Spur.
chinese: 太阳系位于银河系一段叫猎户支臂的区域。

english: Proxima Centauri is the closest star to the Sun.
chinese: 比邻星是距离太阳最近的另一颗恒星。

english: Sirius is the brightest star in Earth's night sky as seen with the unaided eye.
chinese: 从地球上用肉眼看，天狼星是夜空中最亮的恒星。

english: A planet that orbits a star outside our solar system is an exoplanet.
chinese: 绕太阳系外恒星运行的行星叫系外行星。

english: A star can appear slightly dimmer when an orbiting planet passes in front of it.
chinese: 行星从恒星前方经过时，恒星看起来可能会稍微变暗。

english: Some neutron stars are observed as pulsars because their beams sweep past Earth repeatedly.
chinese: 一些中子星的辐射束反复扫过地球，因此会被观测到周期性脉冲。

english: White dwarfs are compact remnants of stars similar to the Sun.
chinese: 白矮星是类似太阳的恒星演化后留下的致密残骸。

english: Some heavy elements are produced when neutron stars merge.
chinese: 一些重元素可以在中子星合并时形成。

english: A black hole's event horizon is the boundary beyond which light cannot escape.
chinese: 黑洞的事件视界是光一旦越过就无法逃出的边界。

english: The Hubble Space Telescope was launched aboard a space shuttle in 1990.
chinese: 哈勃空间望远镜于 1990 年由航天飞机送入太空。

english: The James Webb Space Telescope observes primarily in infrared light.
chinese: 詹姆斯·韦布空间望远镜主要利用红外光进行观测。

english: The first crewed landing on the Moon was Apollo 11 in 1969.
chinese: 1969 年，阿波罗 11 号完成了首次载人登月。

english: Voyager 2 is the only spacecraft to have flown past both Uranus and Neptune.
chinese: 旅行者 2 号是唯一飞掠过天王星和海王星的探测器。

english: The first artificial satellite, Sputnik 1, was launched in 1957.
chinese: 人类第一颗人造卫星斯普特尼克 1 号于 1957 年发射。

english: In low Earth orbit, spacecraft can circle Earth in roughly 90 minutes.
chinese: 在近地轨道上，航天器绕地球一周可以只需约 90 分钟。

english: A geostationary satellite stays above the same point on Earth's equator.
chinese: 地球静止轨道卫星始终位于赤道上同一点的上方。

english: An astronomical unit is defined as exactly 149,597,870.7 kilometers.
chinese: 一个天文单位的定义是 149,597,870.7 千米。

english: Many kangaroos use their tails as a fifth limb when walking slowly.
chinese: 许多袋鼠慢走时会用尾巴撑地，像在使用第五条腿。

english: Koalas have fingerprints with ridge patterns.
chinese: 考拉的指尖也有纹线，会留下指纹。

english: Wombats produce cube-shaped droppings.
chinese: 袋熊的粪便呈近似立方体。

english: The platypus lays eggs even though it is a mammal.
chinese: 鸭嘴兽虽然是哺乳动物，却会产卵。

english: Echidnas also lay eggs and feed their young with milk.
chinese: 针鼹也会产卵，并用乳汁喂养幼崽。

english: Bats are the only mammals capable of sustained powered flight.
chinese: 蝙蝠是唯一能够持续主动飞行的哺乳动物。

english: Flying squirrels glide using a membrane stretched between their limbs.
chinese: 鼯鼠用四肢之间展开的皮膜滑翔。

english: Sea otters sometimes use stones to break open shellfish.
chinese: 海獭有时会用石头敲开贝壳。

english: Flamingos get much of their pink coloration from pigments in their food.
chinese: 火烈鸟的粉红色很大程度上来自食物中的色素。

english: Penguins use their wings as flippers underwater.
chinese: 企鹅在水下把翅膀当作鳍来划水。

english: Hummingbirds can hover and fly backward.
chinese: 蜂鸟既能在空中悬停，也能倒着飞。

english: Woodpeckers use drumming to communicate as well as pecking to find food.
chinese: 啄木鸟除了啄木找食，还会通过敲击声交流。

english: An owl can turn its head about 270 degrees in either direction.
chinese: 猫头鹰的头向任一侧都可转动约 270 度。

english: Many birds fluff up their feathers to trap insulating air.
chinese: 许多鸟会蓬起羽毛，把能保暖的空气留在羽毛之间。

english: Ostriches have two toes on each foot.
chinese: 鸵鸟每只脚只有两根脚趾。

english: The African gray parrot can imitate many kinds of sounds.
chinese: 非洲灰鹦鹉能够模仿多种声音。

english: Crows can use tools to reach food.
chinese: 一些乌鸦会用工具够取食物。

english: Gray whales can feed by scooping sediment from the seafloor.
chinese: 灰鲸可以吸起海底沉积物，再从中滤出食物。

english: Dolphins use echoes to help locate objects underwater.
chinese: 海豚会利用回声定位水下物体。

english: Whale sharks are fish and feed by filtering water.
chinese: 鲸鲨属于鱼类，通过过滤海水来获取食物。

english: Shark skeletons are made mainly of cartilage.
chinese: 鲨鱼骨骼主要由软骨构成。

english: Many sharks can detect weak electric fields from nearby animals.
chinese: 许多鲨鱼能感知附近动物产生的微弱电场。

english: Clownfish can live among the stinging tentacles of sea anemones.
chinese: 小丑鱼能够生活在海葵带有刺细胞的触手之间。

english: Male seahorses carry developing embryos in a brood pouch.
chinese: 雄性海马用育儿袋携带发育中的胚胎。

english: Mudskippers can spend time out of water on damp mudflats.
chinese: 弹涂鱼可以离开水，在潮湿的泥滩上活动。

english: Pufferfish can gulp water to make their bodies swell.
chinese: 河豚可以吞水让身体鼓起来。

english: Some electric rays produce discharges using specialized organs.
chinese: 一些电鳐能利用专门的器官放电。

english: Corals are animals, and many reef-building corals live with microscopic algae.
chinese: 珊瑚是动物，许多造礁珊瑚与微小藻类共生。

english: Sea stars move with rows of tiny tube feet.
chinese: 海星靠成排的小管足移动。

english: The hard outer structure of a sea urchin is called a test.
chinese: 海胆包在身体外面的硬壳由骨板拼成。

english: Jellyfish have no bones.
chinese: 水母没有骨骼。

english: Cuttlefish can change both the color and texture of their skin.
chinese: 乌贼能改变皮肤的颜色和表面质地。

english: Many octopuses can squeeze through openings barely wider than their hard beaks.
chinese: 不少章鱼能挤过只比坚硬喙部稍宽的缝隙。

english: Squid can propel themselves by forcing water out through a siphon.
chinese: 鱿鱼能通过漏斗喷水，借反作用力推动身体。

english: Horseshoe crabs are more closely related to spiders than to true crabs.
chinese: 鲎与蜘蛛的亲缘关系比与真正的螃蟹更近。

english: Spider silk comes out through structures called spinnerets.
chinese: 蜘蛛丝由叫作纺器的结构吐出。

english: Dragonflies spend the earlier part of their lives underwater.
chinese: 蜻蜓的幼体阶段生活在水中。

english: Butterflies can taste chemicals with receptors on their feet.
chinese: 蝴蝶可以用脚上的感受器尝到化学物质。

english: Honeybees can communicate a food source's direction through a waggle dance.
chinese: 蜜蜂可以用摇摆舞告诉同伴食物的方向。

english: Ants often use chemical trails to guide nestmates to food.
chinese: 蚂蚁常用化学气味留下路径，引导同伴找到食物。

english: Fireflies produce light through a chemical reaction in their bodies.
chinese: 萤火虫靠体内的化学反应发光。

english: Some geckos cling to surfaces using millions of microscopic hairs on their toes.
chinese: 一些壁虎靠脚趾上的数百万根微小刚毛附着在表面。

english: Snakes use their tongues to collect chemical traces from their surroundings.
chinese: 蛇用舌头采集周围的化学气味线索。

english: A turtle's shell includes structures connected to its ribs and spine.
chinese: 龟壳包含与肋骨、脊柱相连的结构。

english: Many frogs absorb water through their skin.
chinese: 许多青蛙可以通过皮肤吸收水分。

english: Axolotls usually retain external gills as adults.
chinese: 美西螈通常在成年后仍保留外鳃。

english: Ferns reproduce using spores rather than flowers.
chinese: 蕨类植物通过孢子繁殖，不开花。

english: Mosses lack the true roots found in many larger plants.
chinese: 苔藓没有许多高等植物所具有的真根。

english: Pine cones carry reproductive structures of pine trees.
chinese: 松果是松树的繁殖结构。

english: A pineapple forms from many flowers whose fruits fuse together.
chinese: 一个菠萝由许多朵花形成的小果实融合而成。

english: The deepest known part of the ocean is Challenger Deep in the Mariana Trench.
chinese: 已知最深的海底地点叫挑战者深渊，位于马里亚纳海沟。

english: The ocean covers about 71 percent of Earth's surface.
chinese: 海洋覆盖地球表面约 71% 的面积。

english: Most of Earth's liquid surface water is salty ocean water.
chinese: 地球表面的液态水绝大部分是含盐的海水。

english: Antarctica is classified as a desert because it receives so little precipitation.
chinese: 南极洲降水极少，因此也是一片沙漠。

english: The Sahara is the world's largest hot desert.
chinese: 撒哈拉是世界上最大的热带沙漠。

english: The tides are driven mainly by the gravitational effects of the Moon and the Sun.
chinese: 潮汐主要由月球和太阳的引力效应造成。

english: Spring tides usually occur near a new or full moon.
chinese: 潮差较大的大潮通常发生在新月和满月附近。

english: In the term spring tide, spring refers to the idea of surging or rising, not the season.
chinese: 大潮说的是高潮和低潮之间的落差，与春天无关。

english: Most tsunamis originate from sudden movement of the seafloor during earthquakes.
chinese: 多数海啸由地震造成的海底突然位移引发。

english: Some ocean currents are driven by differences in water temperature and salinity.
chinese: 海水温度和盐度的差异可以驱动一些洋流。

english: Hydrothermal vents release heated, mineral-rich water from beneath the seafloor.
chinese: 海底热液喷口会喷出地下受热、富含矿物质的水。

english: Some microbes near deep-sea vents obtain energy from chemicals instead of sunlight.
chinese: 深海热液喷口附近有些微生物从化学物质获取能量，无需阳光。

english: Sea ice forms when ocean water freezes.
chinese: 海冰由海水冻结而成。

english: Many icebergs start as pieces broken off from glaciers or ice shelves.
chinese: 许多冰山是从冰川或冰架脱落的大块冰。

english: A glacier can flow slowly under its own weight.
chinese: 冰川会在自身重量作用下缓慢流动。

english: The Himalayas formed as the Indian and Eurasian plates collided.
chinese: 印度板块与欧亚板块碰撞形成了喜马拉雅山脉。

english: Iceland straddles the Mid-Atlantic Ridge.
chinese: 冰岛横跨大西洋中脊。

english: Earth's outer core is liquid, while its inner core is solid.
chinese: 地球外核是液态的，内核是固态的。

english: Movement of conducting liquid in Earth's outer core helps generate its magnetic field.
chinese: 地球外核中导电液体的运动是地磁场形成的主要原因。

english: Magma that reaches Earth's surface is called lava.
chinese: 喷到地表的岩浆叫熔岩。

english: Pumice can float for a while because it contains many air-filled holes.
chinese: 浮石里有许多充气孔隙，因此可以在水面漂浮一段时间。

english: Obsidian is a natural volcanic glass.
chinese: 黑曜石是天然的火山玻璃。

english: Basalt makes up much of the ocean floor's upper crust.
chinese: 海洋地壳的上部有相当一部分由玄武岩构成。

english: Marble can form when limestone is transformed by heat and pressure.
chinese: 石灰岩在高温和压力作用下可以变成大理岩。

english: Many caves form because slightly acidic water dissolves limestone over time.
chinese: 许多洞穴是微酸性的水长期溶解石灰岩形成的。

english: Stalactites hang from cave ceilings, while stalagmites grow from the floor.
chinese: 钟乳石从洞顶垂下，石笋从洞底向上长。

english: Amber is fossilized plant resin.
chinese: 琥珀是植物树脂形成的化石。

english: Some fossils preserve footprints rather than body parts.
chinese: 有些化石保存的是足印，而非动物身体的一部分。

english: Loess is sediment made largely of windblown silt.
chinese: 黄土主要由风搬运并沉积的粉砂组成。

english: A river delta forms when sediment collects near the river's mouth.
chinese: 泥沙在河口附近堆积，可以形成三角洲。

english: A fjord is a long, narrow sea inlet carved by a glacier.
chinese: 峡湾是冰川侵蚀形成、后来被海水淹没的狭长水道。

english: A river bend can be cut off to form an oxbow lake.
chinese: 弯曲的河道被切断后，旧河湾可能变成牛轭湖。

english: Snow crystals commonly show sixfold symmetry.
chinese: 雪晶常呈现六重对称。

english: Fog is essentially a cloud near the ground.
chinese: 雾可以理解为贴近地面的一层云。

english: Dew forms when water vapor condenses on a cool surface.
chinese: 水蒸气在冷表面凝结成水滴，就形成了露水。

english: Hailstones can grow when storm updrafts keep ice particles aloft.
chinese: 雷暴中的上升气流可以托住冰粒，使它们继续长成冰雹。

english: The eye of a mature tropical cyclone can be relatively calm.
chinese: 成熟热带气旋的风眼内可能相对平静。

english: An aurora is produced when energized particles interact with gases in the upper atmosphere.
chinese: 高能粒子与高层大气中的气体相互作用时可以产生极光。

english: Ozone high in Earth's atmosphere absorbs much of the Sun's ultraviolet radiation.
chinese: 地球高层大气中的臭氧能吸收太阳照来的大量紫外线。

english: Nitrogen makes up about 78 percent of dry air.
chinese: 干燥空气中约有 78% 是氮气。

english: The oceans absorb a substantial share of the carbon dioxide released by human activities.
chinese: 人类活动排放的二氧化碳有相当一部分被海洋吸收。

english: Past glaciers shaped much of the basins that now hold the Great Lakes.
chinese: 北美五大湖的大部分湖盆由过去的冰川塑造。

english: Lake Baikal is the deepest lake in the world.
chinese: 贝加尔湖是世界上最深的湖泊。

english: The Caspian Sea is an inland body of water with no natural outlet to the ocean.
chinese: 里海是一片内陆水域，没有通向海洋的天然出口。

english: The Danube flows into the Black Sea.
chinese: 多瑙河最终流入黑海。

english: The Yangtze River flows into the East China Sea.
chinese: 长江最终流入东海。

english: The Strait of Gibraltar links the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea.
chinese: 直布罗陀海峡连接大西洋和地中海。

english: The Bering Strait separates mainland Asia from mainland North America.
chinese: 白令海峡将亚洲大陆与北美洲大陆隔开。

english: The Suez Canal connects the Mediterranean Sea with the Red Sea.
chinese: 苏伊士运河连接地中海与红海。

english: The Panama Canal connects the Atlantic and Pacific sides of Panama through a system of locks.
chinese: 巴拿马运河通过船闸系统连接巴拿马的大西洋一侧与太平洋一侧。

english: Sound generally travels faster through water than through air.
chinese: 声音在水中的传播速度通常比在空气中更快。

english: A sonic boom is associated with shock waves produced by something moving faster than sound.
chinese: 物体超音速运动产生的激波与音爆有关。

english: The pitch of a simple tone depends on its frequency.
chinese: 单一音调的高低取决于声波频率。

english: An echo is sound that has bounced back from a surface.
chinese: 回声是声波被表面反射后传回来的声音。

english: An approaching siren sounds higher in pitch because of the Doppler effect.
chinese: 由于多普勒效应，接近时的警笛声听起来音调较高。

english: Light bends when it passes between materials where it travels at different speeds.
chinese: 光进入传播速度不同的介质时，方向可能发生改变。

english: A prism can spread white light into colors by bending different wavelengths by different amounts.
chinese: 棱镜对不同波长的光折射程度不同，因此能把白光分出不同颜色。

english: Optical fibers guide light using total internal reflection.
chinese: 光纤利用全反射引导光线传播。

english: Polarized sunglasses can reduce glare from horizontal surfaces such as water.
chinese: 偏光太阳镜能减弱水面等水平表面产生的眩光。

english: A camera lens changes focus to bring objects at different distances into sharp view.
chinese: 相机镜头通过对焦，让不同距离的物体清晰成像。

english: The image in a plane mirror appears as far behind the mirror as the object is in front of it.
chinese: 平面镜中的像看起来在镜后方，其距离等于物体到镜面的距离。

english: A magnifying glass uses a converging lens.
chinese: 放大镜利用的是会聚透镜。

english: Blue light is scattered more strongly than red light by molecules in clear air.
chinese: 晴朗空气中的分子对蓝光的散射比对红光更强。

english: Sunlight travels through more atmosphere at sunset than when the Sun is high overhead.
chinese: 与太阳高悬时相比，日落时的阳光穿过了更长的一段大气。

english: A solar cell converts light directly into electricity.
chinese: 太阳能电池可以直接把光能转化为电能。

english: An electric motor converts electrical energy into mechanical motion.
chinese: 电动机把电能转化为机械运动。

english: A generator can produce electricity by moving conductors and magnetic fields relative to each other.
chinese: 让导体与磁场相对运动，可以用发电机产生电能。

english: A compass needle aligns with the local magnetic field.
chinese: 指南针的指针会沿当地磁场的方向排列。

english: An electromagnet can be switched off by stopping its electric current.
chinese: 切断电流，就能关闭电磁铁。

english: Some materials generate an electrical signal when squeezed, a property called piezoelectricity.
chinese: 有些材料受到挤压时会产生电信号，这叫压电效应。

english: Quartz watches use the regular vibration of a small crystal to keep time.
chinese: 石英表利用小晶体的规律振动来计时。

english: A pendulum swings more slowly when its length is increased, all else equal.
chinese: 其他条件相同时，摆越长，摆动得越慢。

english: In a vacuum, a feather and a metal ball fall with the same acceleration.
chinese: 在真空中，羽毛与金属球自由落下时的加速度相同。

english: A moving bicycle wheel has angular momentum.
chinese: 转动的自行车车轮具有角动量。

english: A figure skater can spin faster by pulling their arms inward.
chinese: 花样滑冰运动员把手臂收拢时，转速可以变快。

english: A lever can trade a longer movement for a smaller required force.
chinese: 利用杠杆，可以用更长的移动距离换取更小的施力。

english: A fixed pulley can change the direction of a pull.
chinese: 定滑轮能够改变拉力的方向。

english: A hydraulic jack uses pressure transmitted through a liquid to lift a load.
chinese: 液压千斤顶利用液体传递压力，把重物举起来。

english: A ship floats when it displaces water whose weight balances its own.
chinese: 船排开的水所产生的浮力与船的重量平衡时，船就能浮着。

english: A hot-air balloon rises because the heated air inside is less dense than the surrounding air.
chinese: 热气球内部的热空气比外部空气稀薄，因此气球能升空。

english: Salt lowers the freezing point of water when dissolved in it.
chinese: 盐溶在水中会降低水的凝固点。

english: Water is densest near 4 degrees Celsius at ordinary pressure.
chinese: 在通常压力下，水在接近 4 摄氏度时密度最大。

english: Dry ice is solid carbon dioxide.
chinese: 干冰是固态二氧化碳。

english: Dry ice turns directly into gas at ordinary atmospheric pressure.
chinese: 在普通大气压下，干冰直接从固体变成气体。

english: Evaporating sweat cools the skin by carrying away heat.
chinese: 汗液蒸发会带走热量，让皮肤降温。

english: A vacuum flask limits heat transfer by placing a low-pressure gap between its walls.
chinese: 保温瓶两层壁之间的低压空间能减少热量传递。

english: Metal often feels colder than wood at the same temperature because it draws heat from a hand faster.
chinese: 同温度的金属往往比木头摸起来冷，因为它从手上导走热量更快。

english: An ordinary refrigerator moves heat from its cool interior to the room.
chinese: 普通冰箱把内部的热量转移到外面的房间。

english: A pressure cooker raises water's boiling point by increasing the pressure inside.
chinese: 高压锅提高锅内压力，从而提高水的沸点。

english: A thermos can keep liquids cool as well as warm by slowing heat transfer.
chinese: 保温瓶能减缓热交换，既可以保温，也可以保冷。

english: Rust commonly forms when iron reacts with oxygen in the presence of water.
chinese: 铁在水和氧气共同作用下容易生锈。

english: Stainless steel resists corrosion partly because chromium helps form a protective surface layer.
chinese: 不锈钢中的铬能帮助形成表面保护层，因此更耐腐蚀。

english: Aluminum rapidly develops a thin oxide coating when exposed to air.
chinese: 铝接触空气后会很快形成一层薄薄的氧化膜。

english: Diamond and graphite are different structural forms of carbon.
chinese: 金刚石和石墨都由碳组成，但碳原子的排列方式不同。

english: Graphite can conduct electricity even though diamond generally does not.
chinese: 石墨能导电，而普通金刚石通常不导电。

english: Glass is usually an amorphous solid without a long-range crystal structure.
chinese: 普通玻璃是非晶态固体，没有长程有序的晶体结构。

english: Soaps contain molecules with one end attracted to water and another attracted to oils.
chinese: 肥皂分子的一端容易与水结合，另一端容易与油脂结合。

english: Baking soda reacts with acids to release carbon dioxide.
chinese: 小苏打与酸反应会释放二氧化碳。

english: Yeast releases carbon dioxide as it ferments sugars, helping bread dough rise.
chinese: 酵母发酵糖分时会产生二氧化碳，让面团膨起来。

english: Cut apple surfaces often brown because enzymes help their compounds react with oxygen.
chinese: 苹果切面变褐，常是因为酶促进了果肉成分与氧气发生反应。

english: The interior angles of a triangle on a flat plane add to 180 degrees.
chinese: 平面三角形的三个内角之和是 180 度。

english: A triangle drawn on a sphere can have three right angles.
chinese: 球面上可以画出三个角都是直角的三角形。

english: A regular hexagon can be divided into six equilateral triangles.
chinese: 一个正六边形可以分成六个等边三角形。

english: Exactly five convex regular polyhedra exist.
chinese: 每个面都是相同正多边形、每个顶点结构也相同的凸多面体只有五种。

english: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges, and 8 vertices.
chinese: 立方体有 6 个面、12 条棱和 8 个顶点。

english: A cube and a regular octahedron are dual solids.
chinese: 把立方体各面的中心连起来，可得到正八面体。

english: A regular dodecahedron has 12 pentagonal faces.
chinese: 正十二面体由 12 个正五边形面围成。

english: A circle has infinitely many lines of reflection symmetry.
chinese: 圆有无数条轴对称的对称轴。

english: The diameter is the longest chord of a circle.
chinese: 直径是圆中最长的弦。

english: Doubling the radius of a circle makes its area four times as large.
chinese: 圆的半径加倍，面积会变成原来的四倍。

english: Doubling a cube's edge length multiplies its volume by eight.
chinese: 立方体的棱长加倍，体积会变成原来的八倍。

english: A Möbius strip has one side and one boundary loop.
chinese: 莫比乌斯带只有一个面和一条闭合边界。

english: A torus has the same basic surface shape as the skin of a doughnut with a hole.
chinese: 环面就像一个带孔甜甜圈的外表面。

english: The decimal expansion of one third repeats the digit 3 forever.
chinese: 三分之一写成小数时，数字 3 会一直循环。

english: The square root of two cannot be written as a ratio of integers.
chinese: 根号 2 无法写成两个整数的比。

english: The decimal digits of pi never settle into a repeating cycle.
chinese: 圆周率的小数部分不会出现无限循环的固定节。

english: The number zero is even.
chinese: 0 是偶数，因为它可以被 2 整除。

english: The number one is neither prime nor composite.
chinese: 1 既不是质数，也不是合数。

english: There are infinitely many prime numbers.
chinese: 质数有无穷多个。

english: The sum of the first n positive odd integers is n squared.
chinese: 前 n 个正奇数相加，结果等于 n 的平方。

english: An integer is divisible by 9 exactly when the sum of its decimal digits is divisible by 9.
chinese: 一个整数能被 9 整除，当且仅当各位数字之和能被 9 整除。

english: Every square number ends in 0, 1, 4, 5, 6, or 9 in base ten.
chinese: 十进制中，完全平方数的个位只能是 0、1、4、5、6 或 9。

english: The 3-4-5 triangle is a right triangle.
chinese: 边长分别为 3、4、5 的三角形是直角三角形。

english: The first four positive integers multiply to 24.
chinese: 最小的四个正整数相乘等于 24。

english: The number 6 equals the sum of its positive divisors other than itself.
chinese: 6 除自身以外的正因数是 1、2、3，三个数之和恰好是 6。

english: In the Fibonacci sequence, each term after the first two is the sum of the previous two.
chinese: 斐波那契数列从第三项起，每一项等于前两项之和。

english: A standard chessboard has 204 squares if you count all sizes.
chinese: 把各种大小的正方形都算上，一块标准国际象棋棋盘共有 204 个正方形。

english: The opposite faces of a conventional six-sided die add to 7.
chinese: 普通六面骰子的任意两个相对面，点数之和都是 7。

english: There are 36 equally likely ordered outcomes when rolling two fair six-sided dice.
chinese: 同时掷两枚公平的六面骰子，按骰子各自的点数区分共有 36 种等可能结果。

english: With 13 people, at least two were born in the same calendar month.
chinese: 13 个人中，至少有两人的出生月份相同。

english: With 367 people, at least two share a birthday by month and day.
chinese: 367 个人中，至少有两人的生日月和日相同，即使把闰日也算进去。

english: In the Gregorian calendar, 1900 was not a leap year but 2000 was.
chinese: 按公历规则，1900 年不是闰年，2000 年是闰年。

english: A 400-year Gregorian calendar cycle contains 97 leap years.
chinese: 公历每 400 年有 97 个闰年。

english: A full turn equals 360 degrees or 2 pi radians.
chinese: 转一整圈等于 360 度，也等于 2π 弧度。

english: A 10 percent increase followed by a 10 percent decrease leaves 99 percent of the original amount.
chinese: 先增加 10%，再按增加后的数值减少 10%，结果是原数值的 99%。

english: Folding a sheet in half once doubles the number of layers.
chinese: 把一张纸对折一次，纸的层数会翻倍。

english: The binary numeral 1010 represents ten in decimal.
chinese: 二进制的 1010 等于十进制的 10。

english: One byte contains eight bits in modern common usage.
chinese: 现代计算机通常规定一个字节由八个比特组成。

english: An RGB display can create many colors by varying three primary light channels.
chinese: RGB 显示屏通过改变红、绿、蓝三种光的强度呈现多种颜色。

english: PNG compression can preserve every pixel of the original image.
chinese: PNG 可以无损压缩图像，保留原图的每个像素。

english: Standard JPEG photo compression can discard some image information to save space.
chinese: 常用的 JPEG 照片压缩会舍弃部分图像信息，以节省存储空间。

english: A QR code can still be read when some of its data modules are obscured.
chinese: 二维码具有纠错能力，部分数据格被遮挡时仍有可能读出。

english: GPS receivers estimate distance from satellites using signal timing.
chinese: GPS 接收器根据卫星信号的传播时间估算距离。

english: GPS satellite clocks need adjustments that account for relativity.
chinese: GPS 卫星的时钟需要考虑相对论效应进行校正。

english: Submarine fiber-optic cables carry data between continents.
chinese: 海底光缆可以在大洲之间传输数据。

english: UTF-8 can encode a character using between one and four bytes.
chinese: UTF-8 用一到四个字节来编码一个字符对应的码点。

english: A mechanical keyboard uses individual switches beneath its keys.
chinese: 机械键盘的每个按键下都有独立的开关。

english: A capacitive touchscreen senses changes in an electrical property called capacitance.
chinese: 电容式触摸屏通过检测电容变化感知触摸。

english: Many 3D printers build an object by stacking thin layers of material.
chinese: 3D 打印机可以逐层堆叠材料，把平面的一层层结构变为立体物体。

english: A sandboxed program runs with limits on what it can access.
chinese: 在沙箱里运行的程序会受到访问范围的限制。

english: Hydrogen has atomic number 1 and is the lightest element.
chinese: 氢的原子序数是 1，是最轻的元素。

english: Helium takes its name from Helios, the Greek name associated with the Sun.
chinese: 氦的英文名源自与太阳有关的希腊名 Helios。

english: Lithium is the lightest metal.
chinese: 锂是最轻的金属。

english: Beryllium is used in some X-ray windows because it transmits X-rays relatively well.
chinese: 铍能较好地透过 X 射线，因此可用来做某些 X 射线窗口。

english: Boron is part of the composition of borosilicate glass.
chinese: 硼是硼硅酸盐玻璃的成分之一。

english: Carbon-14 can be used to date once-living material.
chinese: 碳-14 可用来测定曾经有生命的材料的年代。

english: Ozone molecules have three oxygen atoms each.
chinese: 一个臭氧分子含有三个氧原子。

english: A pure neon discharge gives off a reddish-orange glow.
chinese: 纯氖气放电时会发出橙红色光。

english: Sodium's symbol Na comes from the name natrium.
chinese: 钠的元素符号 Na 来自名称 natrium。

english: Magnesium burns with a bright white light.
chinese: 镁燃烧时会发出明亮的白光。

english: Silicon is widely used as a semiconductor in computer chips.
chinese: 硅是一种半导体材料，被广泛用于制造计算机芯片。

english: Phosphorus appears in the phosphate backbone of DNA.
chinese: DNA 的骨架含有带磷元素的磷酸基团。

english: Yellow elemental sulfur occurs naturally in some volcanic areas.
chinese: 某些火山地区天然存在黄色的硫单质。

english: Chlorine and sodium are both present in common table salt.
chinese: 普通食盐的主要成分氯化钠由氯和钠组成。

english: Argon is the most abundant noble gas in Earth's atmosphere.
chinese: 氩是地球大气中含量最高的稀有气体。

english: Potassium's symbol K comes from the name kalium.
chinese: 钾的元素符号 K 来自名称 kalium。

english: Calcium carbonate is a major component of many seashells.
chinese: 碳酸钙是许多贝壳的主要成分。

english: Scandium can be added to aluminum alloys in small amounts.
chinese: 微量的钪可加入铝合金，以改变合金的性能。

english: Titanium dioxide is widely used as a white pigment.
chinese: 二氧化钛被广泛用作白色颜料。

english: Vanadium is used in some high-strength steels.
chinese: 钒可作为合金元素加入某些高强度钢。

english: Chromium compounds can give emeralds their green color.
chinese: 铬可以让祖母绿呈现绿色。

english: Manganese dioxide is used in common alkaline batteries.
chinese: 普通碱性电池会用到二氧化锰。

english: Iron's chemical symbol Fe comes from the Latin word ferrum.
chinese: 铁的元素符号 Fe 来自拉丁语 ferrum。

english: Cobalt compounds have long been used to make blue ceramic glazes.
chinese: 人们很早就用含钴化合物制作蓝色陶瓷釉。

english: Nickel is present in many everyday stainless steels.
chinese: 许多日常使用的不锈钢含有镍。

english: Copper has the symbol Cu, derived from the Latin cuprum.
chinese: 铜的元素符号 Cu 来自拉丁语 cuprum。

english: A zinc coating can protect steel from rusting.
chinese: 在钢材表面镀锌，有助于防止钢材生锈。

english: Pure gallium melts at a temperature just below typical human body temperature.
chinese: 纯镓的熔点比人体的正常体温低。

english: Germanium was used as the semiconductor in the first working transistor.
chinese: 第一个成功工作的晶体管使用了锗作半导体材料。

english: Bromine is a liquid nonmetal at ordinary room temperature.
chinese: 溴在通常的室温下是液态非金属。

english: Krypton can serve as a filling gas in some specialized lamps.
chinese: 某些特殊灯具中可以充入氪气。

english: Strontium salts can give fireworks red colors.
chinese: 锶盐能使烟花呈现红色。

english: Yttrium is used in some phosphors for displays and lighting.
chinese: 有些显示和照明用的荧光材料含有钇。

english: Zirconium alloys can be used for the cladding around nuclear fuel.
chinese: 锆合金可用来制作核燃料外的包壳。

english: Niobium alloys are used in some superconducting magnets.
chinese: 某些超导磁体中会用到铌合金。

english: Molybdenum can help steel retain strength at high temperatures.
chinese: 钼有助于钢材在高温下保持强度。

english: Technetium was the first element identified after being made artificially.
chinese: 锝是第一个通过人工制备而被确认的元素。

english: Silver's chemical symbol Ag comes from the Latin argentum.
chinese: 银的元素符号 Ag 来自拉丁语 argentum。

english: Indium tin oxide is a transparent conductor used in many touchscreens.
chinese: 许多触摸屏使用氧化铟锡作为透明导电材料。

english: Tin and copper are the main ingredients of traditional bronze.
chinese: 传统青铜的主要成分是铜和锡。

english: Antimony's chemical symbol is Sb, from the name stibium.
chinese: 锑的元素符号 Sb 来自名称 stibium。

english: Iodine is named for the violet color of its vapor.
chinese: 碘的英文名源自其蒸气的紫色。

english: An isotope of cesium provides the basis for the modern definition of the second.
chinese: 现代时间单位「秒」的定义以一种铯同位素的跃迁频率为基础。

english: Neodymium is used in some very strong permanent magnets.
chinese: 一些强力永磁体含有钕。

english: Tungsten's chemical symbol W comes from its other name, wolfram.
chinese: 钨的元素符号 W 来自它的另一个名称 wolfram。

english: Platinum is used as a catalyst in some vehicle exhaust systems.
chinese: 某些汽车尾气净化装置会用铂作催化剂。

english: Gold is so malleable that it can be beaten into very thin leaf.
chinese: 黄金延展性很好，可以捶打成很薄的金箔。

english: Mercury is a metal that is liquid at ordinary room temperature.
chinese: 汞是一种在普通室温下呈液态的金属。

english: Lead's chemical symbol Pb comes from the Latin word plumbum.
chinese: 铅的元素符号 Pb 来自拉丁语 plumbum。

english: Bismuth crystals can grow with stepped, hopper-like shapes.
chinese: 铋晶体可以长成有阶梯状凹陷的形状。

english: Sunlight takes about eight minutes to reach Earth.
chinese: 阳光从太阳到达地球大约需要八分钟。

english: The Moon shines by reflecting sunlight.
chinese: 我们看到的月光主要是月球反射的太阳光。

english: Earth rotates from west to east, which makes the Sun appear to rise in the east.
chinese: 地球自西向东自转，因此我们看到太阳从东方升起。

english: A year on Earth is slightly longer than 365 days.
chinese: 地球绕太阳运行一周所需的时间略长于 365 天。

english: Sound cannot travel through a perfect vacuum.
chinese: 声音无法在完全真空中传播。

english: Ice floats because it is less dense than liquid water.
chinese: 冰的密度比液态水小，因此会浮在水面上。

english: A rainbow forms when sunlight is refracted and reflected inside water droplets.
chinese: 阳光在水滴内发生折射和反射，就可能形成彩虹。

english: Water boils at a lower temperature at higher elevations, where air pressure is lower.
chinese: 海拔较高的地方气压较低，水的沸点也较低。

english: Lightning and thunder come from the same event, but light travels faster than sound.
chinese: 闪电和雷声来自同一次放电，但光比声音传播得快。

english: An octopus has three hearts.
chinese: 章鱼有三颗心脏。

english: Bamboo belongs to the grass family.
chinese: 竹子属于禾本科。

english: The largest living species of penguin is the emperor penguin.
chinese: 帝企鹅是现存体型最大的企鹅。

english: Most plant species use light energy to make sugars through photosynthesis.
chinese: 大多数植物利用光能进行光合作用，制造糖类。

english: The Pacific Ocean is the largest ocean on Earth.
chinese: 太平洋是地球上面积最大的海洋。

english: The equator divides Earth into the Northern and Southern Hemispheres.
chinese: 赤道把地球划分为北半球和南半球。

english: Two is the only even prime number.
chinese: 2 是唯一的偶数质数。

english: Boyuan's company profile dates its founding to September 2005.
chinese: 铂源官网介绍，公司始建于 2005 年 9 月。

english: Boyuan's company profile dates its drug manufacturing license to January 2012.
chinese: 铂源官网介绍，公司于 2012 年 1 月取得药品生产许可证。

english: Boyuan's company profile identifies Jibei Economic Development Zone in Jinan as its plant location.
chinese: 铂源官网介绍，公司厂址位于济南市济北经济开发区。

english: Boyuan's company profile describes research, manufacturing, and sales as parts of its API and pharmaceutical intermediate business.
chinese: 铂源官网介绍，公司的原料药和医药中间体业务涵盖科研、生产和销售。

english: Boyuan's company profile records recognition as a high-tech enterprise in 2010.
chinese: 铂源官网介绍，公司于 2010 年被认定为高新技术企业。

english: Boyuan's company profile records its selection for a Jinan intellectual property pilot program in 2011.
chinese: 铂源官网介绍，公司于 2011 年被济南市知识产权局认定为知识产权试点企业。

english: Boyuan's website reports that the company attended the 89th API China exhibition in Nanjing in October 2023.
chinese: 铂源官网记载，公司于 2023 年 10 月在南京参加第 89 届 API China 展会。

english: The API China exhibition featured in Boyuan's news covers materials, intermediates, packaging, and equipment.
chinese: 铂源参展新闻中的 API China 展会涵盖医药原料、中间体、包装和设备。

english: Boyuan's homepage groups public product listings by areas such as oncology, antifungals, and analgesia.
chinese: 铂源官网按抗肿瘤、抗真菌和镇痛等领域组织公开产品目录。

english: Boyuan's public homepage highlights pemetrexed acid and palbociclib-related products.
chinese: 铂源官网首页展示了培美曲塞酸和帕博塞布相关产品。

english: Boyuan's oncology catalog includes a palbociclib intermediate.
chinese: 铂源官网的抗肿瘤目录列有帕博塞布中间体。

english: Boyuan's oncology catalog lists several distinct compounds as lapatinib intermediates.
chinese: 铂源官网的抗肿瘤目录把多种结构不同的化合物列为拉帕替尼中间体。

english: Boyuan's oncology catalog lists dasatinib in a form called a monohydrate.
chinese: 铂源官网的抗肿瘤目录中列有达沙替尼一水合物。

english: Boyuan's oncology catalog lists a hydrated ditosylate salt of lapatinib.
chinese: 铂源官网的抗肿瘤目录中列有拉帕替尼二对甲苯磺酸盐水合物。

english: Boyuan's analgesic catalog lists both bupivacaine base and bupivacaine hydrochloride.
chinese: 铂源官网的镇痛产品目录分别列出了布比卡因碱和盐酸布比卡因。

english: Boyuan's analgesic catalog lists levobupivacaine hydrochloride separately from bupivacaine hydrochloride.
chinese: 铂源官网在镇痛产品目录中分别列出了盐酸左布比卡因和盐酸布比卡因。

english: Boyuan's antidiabetic catalog lists compounds identified as intermediates for mitiglinide calcium.
chinese: 铂源官网的抗糖尿病产品目录列有米格列奈钙中间体。

english: Boyuan's antidiarrheal catalog lists racecadotril API alongside several related intermediates.
chinese: 铂源官网的抗腹泻产品目录同时列出了消旋卡多曲原料药及其中间体。

english: Palbociclib inhibits two enzymes named cyclin-dependent kinases 4 and 6.
chinese: 帕博塞布抑制两种叫作细胞周期蛋白依赖性激酶 4 和 6 的酶。

english: The US capsule label describes different solubility for palbociclib at different pH values.
chinese: 美国帕博塞布胶囊说明书指出，帕博塞布的溶解性会随 pH 改变。

english: Pemetrexed is classed as an antifolate because it interferes with folate-dependent reactions.
chinese: 培美曲塞属于抗叶酸药物，因为它会干扰依赖叶酸的反应。

english: Levobupivacaine is the S-enantiomer of bupivacaine.
chinese: 左布比卡因是布比卡因的 S 型对映异构体。

english: API stands for active pharmaceutical ingredient.
chinese: API 是 active pharmaceutical ingredient 的缩写，中文通常称为原料药或活性药物成分。

english: A pharmaceutical intermediate is a material used on the way to making an active substance.
chinese: 医药中间体是在制备活性物质过程中使用的一类中间材料。

english: A finished tablet usually contains excipients alongside its active ingredient.
chinese: 成品片剂通常含有活性成分及药用辅料。

english: The same active substance can appear in multiple strengths or finished dosage forms.
chinese: 同一种活性物质可以被制成多种规格或不同剂型的成品药。

english: Two drug products can share an active ingredient while using different excipients.
chinese: 两种药品可以含有相同的活性成分，却采用不同的辅料。

english: An extended-release formulation is designed to release its active ingredient over a longer period.
chinese: 缓释制剂经过设计，可在较长时间内释放活性成分。

english: An enteric coating is intended to resist release in the stomach and allow release farther along the gut.
chinese: 肠溶包衣的设计目的是让制剂在胃内保持完整，在消化道后段释放。

english: A drug's route of administration tells how it enters the body.
chinese: 给药途径描述药物通过何种方式进入人体。

english: In a suspension, fine solid particles are dispersed through a liquid.
chinese: 在混悬液中，细小固体颗粒分散在液体里。

english: In an emulsion, droplets of one liquid are dispersed in another liquid.
chinese: 在乳剂中，一种液体以小液滴形式分散在另一种液体里。

english: An ointment, a cream, and a gel are distinct types of semisolid dosage form.
chinese: 软膏剂、乳膏剂和凝胶剂属于不同类型的半固体剂型。

english: A patch designed for transdermal delivery releases a drug through the skin.
chinese: 经皮给药贴剂可让药物通过皮肤进入体内。

english: A blister pack can isolate each dose in its own cavity.
chinese: 泡罩包装可把每一剂药品放在单独的腔格里。

english: An amber container can reduce exposure to some wavelengths of light.
chinese: 琥珀色容器可以减少内容物受到某些波长的光照。

english: A desiccant protects packaging contents by taking up moisture from the air inside.
chinese: 干燥剂通过吸收包装内部空气中的水分来保护内容物。

english: A container closure system includes the components that contain and protect the product.
chinese: 容器密封系统包括用于盛装和保护产品的各个部件。

english: Disintegration testing looks at how a solid dose breaks apart.
chinese: 崩解试验关注固体剂量单位怎样破碎和分散。

english: Dissolution testing measures how an active ingredient is released into a test liquid over time.
chinese: 溶出试验测量活性成分随时间进入试验液的情况。

english: Tablet friability measures how readily tablets lose material through handling-like abrasion.
chinese: 片剂脆碎度反映片剂在类似搬运的摩擦作用下有多容易掉粉或破损。

english: Tablet breaking force measures the force needed to fracture a tablet under specified conditions.
chinese: 片剂破碎力是在规定条件下压裂片剂所需的力。

english: Content uniformity addresses whether individual dosage units contain comparable amounts of active ingredient.
chinese: 含量均匀度关注各个剂量单位的活性成分含量是否均匀。

english: A binder helps powder particles hold together in a tablet.
chinese: 黏合剂帮助粉粒在片剂中结合在一起。

english: A disintegrant helps a tablet break up after contacting liquid.
chinese: 崩解剂帮助片剂接触液体后分散开来。

english: A tablet lubricant can reduce friction when a compressed tablet is ejected from its die.
chinese: 片剂润滑剂可以减少压好的片剂从模孔推出时的摩擦。

english: A powder glidant is intended to improve how the powder flows.
chinese: 助流剂的作用是改善粉末的流动性。

english: Granulation groups small particles into larger granules.
chinese: 制粒把小颗粒聚集成较大的颗粒。

english: Lyophilization removes ice primarily by sublimation during freeze-drying.
chinese: 在冻干过程中，冰主要通过升华而被除去。

english: Reconstitution means preparing a usable formulation from a dry product by adding the specified liquid.
chinese: 复溶是向干燥制剂加入指定液体，使其恢复为可使用的制剂。

english: An amorphous drug solid lacks the long-range order of a crystal.
chinese: 无定形药物固体缺少晶体那样的长程有序结构。

english: The same drug molecule can pack into more than one crystal structure, a phenomenon called polymorphism.
chinese: 同一种药物分子可以排列成不同的晶体结构，这叫多晶型。

english: Two crystal forms of a drug can have different dissolution behavior.
chinese: 同一种药的两种晶型可能具有不同的溶出表现。

english: A monohydrate contains one water molecule per formula unit.
chinese: 一水合物每个化学式单位含有一个水分子。

english: A solvate contains solvent molecules as part of its crystal structure.
chinese: 溶剂化物的晶体结构中包含溶剂分子。

english: A hygroscopic powder takes up moisture from the surrounding air.
chinese: 吸湿性粉末会从周围空气中吸收水分。

english: Changing the counterion can change the properties of a pharmaceutical salt.
chinese: 更换对离子，可能改变药物盐的物理化学性质。

english: Reducing particle size generally increases surface area per unit mass.
chinese: 减小粒径通常会增加单位质量颗粒的表面积。

english: A particle-size distribution describes a range of sizes instead of a single representative diameter.
chinese: 粒度分布描述的是一批颗粒的大小范围，而非单个代表性直径。

english: A powder can have the same true particle density but a different bulk density depending on how it packs.
chinese: 粉末颗粒的真实密度即使相同，堆积方式不同也会改变堆密度。

english: A retest date indicates when an API should be tested again before further use.
chinese: 复验日期提示原料药在继续使用前应于何时重新检验。

english: A stability study follows product attributes over specified periods and storage conditions.
chinese: 稳定性研究会按规定时间和储存条件追踪产品质量指标。

english: Photostability testing looks for changes associated with light exposure.
chinese: 光稳定性试验用于观察光照引起的变化。

english: The US FDA evaluates generic drug applications for quality and bioequivalence, among other requirements.
chinese: 美国 FDA 审评仿制药申请时，考察项目包括药品质量和生物等效性。

english: Bioequivalence concerns how similarly products make the active ingredient available in the body.
chinese: 生物等效性关注药品使活性成分在体内达到可利用状态的程度是否相近。

english: A reference listed drug is the approved drug product referenced by a US generic drug application.
chinese: 在美国仿制药申报中，参比列名药品是申请所参照的已批准药品。

english: ICH Q7 addresses good manufacturing practice for active pharmaceutical ingredients.
chinese: ICH Q7 关注原料药的药品生产质量管理规范。

english: ICH Q8 addresses pharmaceutical development.
chinese: ICH Q8 关注如何进行药品研发并理解产品和工艺。

english: ICH Q9 deals with quality risk management.
chinese: ICH Q9 的主题是质量风险管理。

english: ICH Q10 describes a pharmaceutical quality system across the product lifecycle.
chinese: ICH Q10 描述了覆盖产品生命周期的制药质量体系。

english: ICH Q11 focuses on developing and manufacturing drug substances.
chinese: ICH Q11 聚焦原料药的开发与生产。

english: ICH Q12 addresses management of postapproval changes across the product lifecycle.
chinese: ICH Q12 涉及药品获批后的生命周期变更管理。

english: ICH Q13 addresses continuous manufacturing of drug substances and drug products.
chinese: ICH Q13 涉及原料药和药品制剂的连续制造。

english: ICH Q14 addresses the development of analytical procedures.
chinese: ICH Q14 关注分析方法的开发。

english: ICH Q2 addresses validation of analytical procedures.
chinese: ICH Q2 关注怎样验证分析方法。

english: ICH Q3C addresses residual solvents in pharmaceuticals.
chinese: ICH Q3C 关注药品中的残留溶剂。

english: ICH Q3D addresses elemental impurities in pharmaceuticals.
chinese: ICH Q3D 关注药品中的元素杂质。

english: ICH Q6A covers specifications for chemically synthesized drug substances and associated products.
chinese: ICH Q6A 涉及化学药物原料及相关制剂的质量标准。

english: A specification includes tests and their acceptance criteria.
chinese: 质量标准既规定检验项目，也规定通过检验的判定标准。

english: A certificate of analysis summarizes test results for the identified batch.
chinese: 检验报告书汇总特定批次的检验结果。

english: A batch identifier lets records, results, and physical material be linked together.
chinese: 批号可以把生产记录、检验结果和实物关联起来。

english: Quarantine status means a material awaits a decision on whether it can be used.
chinese: 物料处于待验状态时，需等待是否可用的判定。

english: A deviation records a departure from an approved instruction or established standard.
chinese: 偏差记录用于记载与批准指令或既定标准不一致的情况。

english: Change control evaluates a proposed change before it is implemented.
chinese: 变更控制要求在实施拟议变更前评估其影响。

english: CAPA stands for corrective and preventive action.
chinese: CAPA 是纠正与预防措施的缩写。

english: A batch production record documents what occurred during the manufacture of that batch.
chinese: 批生产记录记载了一批产品生产过程中实际发生的事项。

english: A retained sample can allow later examination of material from a particular batch.
chinese: 留样可用于日后对特定批次的物料进行复查。

english: A stability-indicating method can distinguish the target substance from relevant degradation products.
chinese: 具有稳定性指示能力的方法可以区分目标物质和相关降解产物。

english: Residual solvents and degradation products are different categories of quality concern.
chinese: 残留溶剂和降解产物属于两类不同的质量关注项。

english: An audit trail preserves information about changes to an electronic record.
chinese: 审计追踪保留电子记录发生变更的信息。

english: A critical quality attribute is a product property that must remain within an appropriate range or limit.
chinese: 关键质量属性是必须控制在适当范围或限度内的产品性质。

english: A control strategy can combine controls on materials, the process, and the finished product.
chinese: 控制策略可以同时涉及原材料、生产过程和成品。

english: A drug master file can supply confidential manufacturing information to the FDA in support of an application.
chinese: 药品主文件可以向美国 FDA 提供支持申报所需的保密生产资料。

english: A certificate of analysis and a safety data sheet answer different questions about a chemical material.
chinese: 检验报告书主要说明批次质量，安全数据表主要说明化学品危害和防护信息。

english: HPLC stands for high-performance liquid chromatography.
chinese: HPLC 是高效液相色谱法的英文缩写。

english: In liquid chromatography, the moving phase is a liquid.
chinese: 液相色谱中的流动相是液体。

english: In gas chromatography, a gas carries compounds through the column.
chinese: 气相色谱由载气推动待分离物质通过色谱柱。

english: Retention time is the time from injection until an analyte peak reaches the detector under stated conditions.
chinese: 在规定条件下，从进样到待测物色谱峰出现所经历的时间叫保留时间。

english: Peak area can be related to the amount of a compound through a suitable calibration.
chinese: 通过适当校准，色谱峰面积可用于估算物质的量。

english: Two peaks that overlap can be harder to quantify individually.
chinese: 两个色谱峰重叠时，分别定量往往更困难。

english: A chromatogram plots detector response against time or another separation coordinate.
chinese: 色谱图把检测器响应与时间等分离坐标对应起来。

english: A blank can reveal a signal caused by reagents or the analytical system itself.
chinese: 空白样可以帮助发现来自试剂或分析系统本身的信号。

english: An internal standard is added in a known amount to help account for variation during analysis.
chinese: 内标物按已知量加入，用于帮助校正分析过程中产生的波动。

english: A calibration curve connects known quantities or concentrations with measured instrument responses.
chinese: 校准曲线把已知量或浓度与仪器给出的响应联系起来。

english: Mass spectrometry sorts or detects ions based on their mass-to-charge ratio.
chinese: 质谱法根据离子的质荷比进行分离或检测。

english: NMR chemical shifts give clues about the local environments of certain atomic nuclei.
chinese: 核磁共振化学位移能提供一些原子核所处局部环境的线索。

english: Infrared spectra contain bands associated with molecular vibrations.
chinese: 红外光谱中可以看到与分子振动有关的吸收带。

english: UV-visible spectroscopy measures how strongly a sample absorbs light at selected wavelengths.
chinese: 紫外可见光谱法测量样品对选定波长的光吸收得有多强。

english: Powder X-ray diffraction can help distinguish crystalline forms of a solid.
chinese: 粉末 X 射线衍射可帮助区分固体的不同晶型。

english: Differential scanning calorimetry can reveal changes such as melting as a sample is heated.
chinese: 差示扫描量热法可在样品受热时观察熔融等变化。

english: Thermogravimetric analysis follows changes in sample mass as temperature or time changes.
chinese: 热重分析追踪样品质量随温度或时间的变化。

english: Karl Fischer titration measures water content.
chinese: 卡尔费休滴定法用于测定水分含量。

english: Optical rotation measures how much a sample turns the plane of polarized light.
chinese: 旋光度衡量样品使平面偏振光的偏振方向转过多少角度。

english: A chiral chromatography column can separate certain pairs of mirror-image molecules.
chinese: 手性色谱柱可以分开某些互成镜像的分子。

english: ICP mass spectrometry can measure many trace elements in one analysis.
chinese: 电感耦合等离子体质谱可在一次分析中同时测量多种痕量元素。

english: Headspace sampling analyzes vapor above a sample and is useful for volatile compounds.
chinese: 顶空取样分析样品上方的气体，适用于检测挥发性成分。

english: System suitability tests check whether an analytical system is performing as required before results are relied on.
chinese: 系统适用性试验用来确认分析系统的表现达到要求，结果才可采用。

english: Accuracy concerns closeness to an accepted reference value.
chinese: 准确度关注测量结果与公认参考值有多接近。

english: Precision concerns agreement among repeated measurements.
chinese: 精密度关注多次重复测量之间的一致程度。

english: Robustness considers whether small deliberate method changes affect performance.
chinese: 方法耐用性考察有意进行的小幅参数变动会不会影响方法表现。

english: The detection limit can be lower than the concentration at which reliable quantitation is possible.
chinese: 检测限可以低于能够可靠定量的浓度。

english: A reference standard provides a defined comparison material for a test.
chinese: 对照品为检验提供已知特性的比较材料。

english: Isomers can have the same molecular formula with different atomic arrangements.
chinese: 异构体的分子式可以相同，但原子的连接方式或空间排列不同。

english: Enantiomers are non-superimposable mirror images, like left and right hands.
chinese: 对映异构体互为镜像却不能重合，就像左手和右手。

english: A racemic mixture contains equal amounts of a pair of enantiomers.
chinese: 外消旋混合物含有等量的一对对映异构体。

english: The R and S designations describe spatial arrangement and do not predict the direction of optical rotation.
chinese: R 和 S 描述空间构型，不能用来判断物质左旋还是右旋。

english: A heterocycle has at least one ring atom that is not carbon.
chinese: 杂环的环骨架中至少有一个非碳原子。

english: Pyridine resembles benzene with one ring carbon and its attached hydrogen replaced by nitrogen.
chinese: 吡啶的环可看作苯环上一个带氢的碳原子被氮替代。

english: Pyrimidine is a six-membered aromatic ring with two nitrogen atoms.
chinese: 嘧啶是含两个氮原子的六元芳香环。

english: Piperazine is a six-membered ring with nitrogen atoms opposite each other.
chinese: 哌嗪有一个六元环，其中两个氮原子位于相对的位置。

english: A zwitterion has both positive and negative charges within the same molecule.
chinese: 两性离子在同一个分子中同时带有正电荷和负电荷基团。

english: Many amino acids can exist as zwitterions.
chinese: 许多氨基酸可以以两性离子的形式存在。

english: A buffer resists changes in pH when small amounts of acid or base are added.
chinese: 加入少量酸或碱时，缓冲液的 pH 变化相对较小。

english: On the pH scale, a difference of one unit corresponds to a tenfold change in hydrogen ion activity.
chinese: pH 相差一个单位，氢离子活度相差十倍。

english: A catalyst can change how fast a reaction proceeds without shifting its equilibrium.
chinese: 催化剂可以改变反应速率，但不会改变反应的平衡位置。

english: A molecule's functional groups help determine the kinds of reactions it can undergo.
chinese: 分子的官能团会影响它能够发生哪些类型的反应。

english: Hydrogen bonding can affect the way drug molecules pack in a crystal.
chinese: 氢键会影响药物分子在晶体中的堆积方式。

english: An ester and an amide both contain a carbonyl group but differ in the atom attached next to it.
chinese: 酯和酰胺都含有羰基，但在羰基旁相连的原子不同，一个是氧，一个是氮。

english: A recrystallized solid and its mother liquor need not contain impurities in the same proportions.
chinese: 重结晶后的固体和留下的母液，杂质比例可能不同。

english: Filtration can separate suspended solids but may let dissolved molecules pass through.
chinese: 过滤可以分离悬浮固体，但溶解状态的分子可能随液体穿过滤材。

english: Adsorption accumulates material on a surface, while absorption transfers it into the bulk of a material.
chinese: 吸附发生在表面，吸收则把物质带进材料内部。

english: A CAS Registry Number identifies a registered substance but does not itself encode its structure.
chinese: CAS 登记号用于识别登记的物质，数字本身不编码其分子结构。
